name: Santa Llogaia d'Àlguema (Spain)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the red cross of the arms with blue rays.
history: The flag was approved by the municipal council on 14 December 1989 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 1241 of 12 January 1990; it is a yellow cloth of 2:3 bearing at its geometric centre the cross of the municipal arms, red with blue rays.

features.role: cross of the arms with blue rays between the arms
